title: Noses
description: NCERT Class 4 English (Marigold): 'Noses'. New words, comprehension, past tense, and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Noses': nose, sniff, smell, curious.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Noses' mean (nose, sniff, smell, curious); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: We use our nose to ___ a flower.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A word that means wanting to know about things is ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: Yesterday I smelled fresh bread in the kitchen.
We went to the zoo and saw the lions.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Noses' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Noses'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The funny poem wonders about all kinds of ___.
The funny poem wonders about all the different kinds of ___.

exemplars: Yesterday I smelled fresh bread in the kitchen.
We went to the zoo and saw the lions.

nodes.title: Past Tense
nodes.teach_focus: The past tense tells what already happened. Add -ed (jumped) or use special forms (go->went, eat->ate).
nodes.success_criteria: Uses past tense correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of past tense.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Choose the past tense: 'She ___ the rose.'

bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: We went to the park and played.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Noses'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Noses': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Last Sunday, I ___ a beautiful garden.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.
A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: Yesterday I smelled fresh bread in the kitchen.
We went to the zoo and saw the lions.

items.prompt: A word that means wanting to know about things is ___.
We use our nose to ___ a flower.
The funny poem wonders about all kinds of ___.
The funny poem wonders about all the different kinds of ___.
Choose the past tense: 'She ___ the rose.'
